title: zic-rs TZDB Evidence Atlas row (zic-rs-atlas-row-v1)
description: One evidence-atlas finding. DERIVED from the canonical reports/tzdb-atlas/atlas.tsv (ATLAS-FORMAT.1) — this schema validates the NDJSON projection, it does not define new evidence. Each row joins one of four evidence axes to a receipt with explicit attribution.

axis.description: evidence axis the finding belongs to

key_fact.description: the receipt-backed fact, stated honestly with its bounds

verdict.description: the row's classification (axis-local vocabulary; not collapsed across axes)

attribution.description: which surface the evidence is attributed to
